meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建带时间轴的可渲染动画或视频项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把分镜或脚本规整成带片段和轨道的可渲染媒体项目
copy.tagline_en: Build a renderable animated or video project with structured clips and tracks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your storyboard or script into a renderable media project with tracks and clips

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的合成契约写可渲染的 HTML 项目：用 data-* 属性声明时间、class="clip"、轨道与子合成、一段暂停的 GSAP 时间线，媒体播放交给框架，并用 CLI 校验与截图。
howto.when: 在你动手写合成 HTML 之前，或任务涉及合成结构、data-* 时间属性、轨道与子合成等话题时接管。

say.text: 帮我从最小骨架开始建一个可渲染的 HyperFrames 合成。
say.note: 会给出最小可渲染合成骨架

say.text: 给我的合成加上子合成和变量，并接好宿主属性。

howto.what_en: Claude writes one renderable HyperFrames HTML project: timing via data-* attributes and class="clip", tracks, sub-compositions, one paused GSAP timeline, framework-owned media playback, plus CLI validation and snapshots.
howto.when_en: Takes over before you write composition HTML, or when the task covers composition structure, data-* timing attributes, tracks, sub-compositions, etc.

say_en.text: Build a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition from the skeleton.
Add a sub-composition and variables, with host wiring.
say_en.note: Wires host attributes and per-instance vars.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check and snapshot to verify the project.
say_en.note: Runs lint checks and mid-frame snapshots.
